heading, Moving patients safely through the entire care pathway, level 2
Isla gives you the tools to manage clinical pathways with total clarity. Patients move efficiently from triage to discharge, so you can free up capacity for those who need you most.
heading, Free up capacity. Deliver better care., level 2

It’s tough to balance clinical care with a mounting admin load. Isla changes that by capturing patient data and automating your routine tasks, giving you the space to act faster and with more confidence.
The result? Safer, more efficient care that scales with your team.

heading, Connect every step of the patient journey, level 2

We built Isla alongside clinicians to make sure it works in the real world. Unlike tools that only fix one problem at a time, our award-winning platform connects every step from triage to recovery, giving you the visibility and control you need to lead your team with confidence.
Get instant context with smart forms and media uploads. Isla helps you triage faster, clearing bottlenecks so patients reach the right pathway sooner.
Sync MDTs and automate PIFU without the scheduling headache. Isla helps you cut delays and free up time, so you can focus clinical expertise where it matters most.
Scalable, proactive care is built in. With remote monitoring and automated risk alerts, your team can spot issues early and keep patients safer at every stage of their journey.
heading, Cut delays, not corners, level 2

Isla powers hundreds of digital pathways across 40+ specialties, giving clinical teams the capacity they need to deliver better care. Most Trusts achieve a 300-400% ROI within just three months. We’re so confident in the results that if you don’t see an ROI after 12 months, we pause billing. It’s that simple.
35 days reduced in outpatient waiting times (RTT)

heading, Built to integrate, designed to scale, level 2
end of heading, Built to integrate, designed to scale, level 2

Configure and deploy pathways that support your existing workflows in just two weeks. With pre-built templates and dedicated support, our IG-secure, NHS-compliant platform connects natively to EMIS, Epic, Cerner, SystmOne, and Rio.
Isla is a UKCA-marked Class 1 medical device, and we are proud to be ISO 9001 certified by the British Assessment Bureau.
You can build limitless clinical pathways with real-time FHIR data exchange. No new hardware, no downloads, and no patient logins required, it’s that simple.
heading, Ready to unlock clinical capacity?, level 2
Healthcare can’t wait. See what’s possible when systems connect and your team is empowered to do more.
Seamless pathways. Better outcomes. Patient-centred, flexible care. Isla is the UKCA-marked Class 1 medical device.
